metadata.note_image_id: INUGPU docker 29.7.2 uses the containerd image store, so its image ID is the OCI index digest (457da255...). A host using the classic overlay2 store reports the config digest (e33dd4e4...) as the ID instead. Either is the same image; the layer diff_ids below must match exactly.
metadata.docker_save_deterministic: two consecutive `docker save cloudgpufit-bench:cu124-v1` on INUGPU gave the same sha256 (2026-11-11)

snapshot.note: Frozen membership of finalized result JSON files at audit start; per-file SHA256 retained. Live run continues; this is not a run-completion assertion.
snapshot.planned_not_yet_run_definition: No finalized result in this snapshot; may include an invocation currently in flight. It does not mean the runner never started it.

evidence_convention.observed_in_results: Result JSON/log or directly observed read-only system output
evidence_convention.code_only: Current code/config/artifact only; not proof of past execution
evidence_convention.unverified: No evidence or absent value. field_evidence applies individually; parent evidence_level supplies default for nested fields unless overridden.

container_mapping_evidence.value: Exact executed command is retained per case in launch.cmd

workload_protocol.input_text: g=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed); input_ids=torch.randint(3, config.vocab_size, (B, L), generator=g, dtype=int64); ids equal to config pad/eos/bos/decoder_start (int or list) -> 3; attention_mask=torch.ones(B, L, dtype=int64). No tokenizer, no BOS insertion, no truncation.
workload_protocol.input_image: g=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed); pixel_values=torch.randn(B, 3, R, R, generator=g, dtype=float32).to(float16). No image processor (no resize/crop).
workload_protocol.input_hash: sha_tensor: contiguous CPU tensor, view(uint8), numpy().tobytes(), SHA256; per-case hashes retained
workload_protocol.generation: GenerationConfig.from_model_config; full actual dict in cases; greedy num_beams=1, do_sample=false, use_cache=true, min=max=N; successful cases have exact requested new tokens
workload_protocol.invocation: CPU source inputs retained, .to(cuda) each invoke inside measured interval; inference_mode; vision model forward once, text generate
workload_protocol.release: warmup/measure GPU inputs and output deleted after end_with_output; synchronize; no explicit empty_cache call in current worker
workload_protocol.peak_reset: before from_pretrained; before each measure after start and trace begin boundary
workload_protocol.finite_check: validate only, hook raw logits for each forward; stored GPU boolean tensors remain referenced through validation measurement
workload_protocol.attn_config_warning: models.json common.attn_implementation=eager is descriptive; worker reads only common.seed and actual --attn; default omits loader attention kwarg
workload_protocol.historical_code_limit: v1 worker source is absent here. v1 result.protocol confirms iterations/cache/reset; current source is not proof of every detail of old worker.

attention_diagnostics.note: decode = kernels(generate 2 tokens) - kernels(generate 1 token); separate process, not a measurement
attention_diagnostics.scope: Separate profiler diagnostic for listed pilot shapes only, not all main395 conditions. Enabled SDPA flags alone do not prove selected kernel. CNN has no attention operation; eager is config value.

xmem.limitation: GPU allocation-event replay validates allocator behavior for these traces; it does not validate CPU-generated operation/request trace equivalence.

metrics.name: measures[].start.{allocated,reserved}
metrics.window_start: after previous output/input release and synchronize, after warmup for i=0
metrics.window_end: before peak reset and before GPU input copies
metrics.maps_to_cpu: CPU live allocations and cached segments after load + warmup 3

metrics.name: measures[].peak.{allocated,reserved}
metrics.window_start: after start/begin boundary, immediately at reset_peak_memory_stats
metrics.window_end: after invoke() and synchronize; GPU inputs/output remain live
metrics.maps_to_cpu: max xMem usage / max segment total in matching measure window

metrics.name: measures[].end_with_output.{allocated,reserved}
metrics.window_end: before sampler stop, output CPU copy and del gi,o
metrics.maps_to_cpu: current usage/segment bytes while GPU inputs/output are referenced

metrics.name: measures[].released.{allocated,reserved}
metrics.window_start: after output copied to CPU and del gi,o
metrics.maps_to_cpu: current allocator state after input/output release; allocator cache retained

metrics.name: after_load
metrics.unit: mixed: *_bytes and max_* bytes; allocation/segment/num_* counts
metrics.maps_to_cpu: load-only current/peak state, before any invocation

metrics.name: measures[].stats_end
metrics.unit: mixed: byte keys bytes, other keys counts
metrics.window_start: peak stats since current reset; cumulative counters since process start
metrics.reset: peak counters reset per measurement; allocation/free counters not explicitly reset
metrics.maps_to_cpu: compare matching counters/peaks; do not treat every key as bytes

metrics.name: measures[].nvml_process_peak_bytes
metrics.window_start: sampler.start after peak reset before invoke
metrics.window_end: sampler.stop after peak/end/stats_end reads; includes final synchronous sample
metrics.reset: new sample list per measured invocation
metrics.maps_to_cpu: not directly allocator reserved/allocated; process memory includes allocator-external overhead
metrics.note: 10ms sampling is not an exact continuous maximum; only measure mode

metrics.name: outside (NVML minus reserved)
metrics.maps_to_cpu: worker does not calculate an outside metric; NVML and reserved maxima are not necessarily simultaneous

metrics.name: history.boundaries
metrics.window_start: history enabled before torch.cuda.init; model_load_begin before load reset
metrics.window_end: measure_0_end after GPU input/output deletion and synchronize
metrics.reset: trace load reset and measure reset only
metrics.maps_to_cpu: replay full event prefix load → warmup_0,1,2 → measure_0; compare at named boundaries

open_questions.question: CPU 예측이 load → warmup 3 → measure_0 전체 prefix를 캐시 유지하며 재생합니까?
open_questions.why: 파일럿의 first start reserved=peak 여부를 run.pilot_comparison_checks에 직접 검산했습니다. cold 측정과 warmed measure_0는 다른 구간입니다.

open_questions.question: 캐시 유지, 입력 GPU 복사와 출력 해제 수명, start 기록 후 peak 리셋 시점이 GPU와 같습니까?
open_questions.why: 입력 복사도 invoke 안에 포함되고 end_with_output에는 GPU 입력과 출력이 살아 있습니다.

open_questions.question: CPU에서 실제 attention 구현과 선택된 aten 연산은 무엇입니까?
open_questions.why: GPU 진단의 sdpa 모델은 FlashAttention 커널이 관측됩니다. T5는 eager, CNN은 attention 없는 모델로 config eager입니다. CPU math SDPA/eager의 중간 텐서는 다를 수 있습니다.

open_questions.question: CPU fp16 미지원 연산은 dtype 승격, 대체 구현, 실패 중 어떻게 처리합니까?
open_questions.why: GPU 실제 param_dtypes는 케이스에 보존했습니다. param dtype만으로 모든 중간 연산 정밀도를 보장하지 않습니다.

open_questions.question: 조건별 input tensor shape/dtype/sha256이 gpu_manifest cases.inputs와 일치합니까?
open_questions.why: seed와 특수 토큰 치환, 이미지 float32 생성 후 fp16 변환까지 일치해야 합니다.

open_questions.question: CPU 예측값은 GPU reserved와 allocated 중 무엇이며 어떤 측정 구간의 최대입니까?
open_questions.why: primary candidate는 summary.first_measure_peak_reserved입니다. NVML은 별도 프로세스 메모리 지표입니다.

open_questions.question: cuBLAS/cuDNN workspace와 CUDA 전용 요청을 모델링합니까?
open_questions.why: GPU trace 재생 일치만으로 CPU 요청 목록의 일치를 입증하지 못합니다.

open_questions.question: GenerationConfig 전체, 모델 revision/loader/use_safetensors 및 생성 길이 검사가 동일합니까?
open_questions.why: 요청한 토큰 길이와 실제 생성 길이를 케이스별로 보존했습니다.

open_questions.question: 이전 v1 worker 원본을 보관하고 있습니까?
open_questions.why: v1 결과 hash와 현재 worker hash가 다릅니다. 현재 코드로 과거의 모든 세부 동작을 확정할 수 없습니다.

open_questions.question: models.json의 common eager 설명 대신 CLI와 결과 attn_requested를 비교 기준으로 사용합니까?
open_questions.why: 현재 runner 기본 default와 common eager 문구가 다르며 worker는 common attention 값을 읽지 않습니다.

open_questions.question: conditions_main395.json의 rule 문구에 남은 generate_main355.py 이름을 문서상 오기로 처리해도 됩니까?
open_questions.why: 실제 생성 스크립트는 generate_main.py이며 실제 조건은 395개입니다. 원본은 수정하지 않았습니다.

open_questions.question: 별도 reserved 진단 실험은 이번 비교에서 제외하는 것이 맞습니까?

open_questions.question: xMem 검증의 범위를 기록된 비교 필드로 한정해 해석합니까?
